US-Iran Tensions Escalate, Impacting Global Markets and Oil Prices

Heightened tensions between the United States and Iran have led to a surge in crude oil prices and a significant drop in global stock markets. The US has revoked sanctions waivers for Iranian oil and conducted airstrikes, while Iran has issued retaliatory threats. These developments have reignited fears of a wider conflict in the Middle East and disrupted oil supply.
